target_customer: Retail investors in Southeast Asia and other emerging markets who want access to US stocks, ETFs and options
problem: Retail investors outside the US had little or no low-cost access to US equities, and local brokers often could not offer fractional shares or US stocks at all.
business_model: Retail brokerage app: commission-free trading with revenue from spreads, fees and interest on cash (Grow feature)

founders.name: Rohit Mulani
founders.background_notes: No background stated in the sources opened. A search result summary lists him as co-founder and CEO while the YC page lists Norman Wanto as CEO; titles conflict.

founders.name: Andrew Haryono
founders.role: Co-founder added at the Indonesia launch (per TechCrunch April 2022)
founders.background_notes: Joined as co-founder around 2022, not at the 2019 founding.

technical_complexity.rationale: A brokerage app needs custodial and clearing integration with a US broker (Alpaca per its blog), fractional share accounting and compliance in several jurisdictions; standard engineering with heavy regulatory work.

defensibility.rationale: Commission-free fractional trading was replicable, but local licensing, such as the Indonesian partnership with a Bappebti-licensed broker, gave some regional protection.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The 2021 seed coverage named Interactive Brokers, Saxo and eToro as main competitors; none acquired Gotrade as of the sources found.

market_need_then: Retail trading interest in US stocks was rising and Robinhood showed commission-free demand, but US residents only; international retail users lacked easy access to US equities. Demand evidence in sources: about 500,000 users in 140+ countries by April 2022.

branding.domain_note: Operates on heygotrade.com with a hey prefix rather than gotrade.com; no source on how the domain was obtained.

identity.voice_and_tone: Positioned as fun, fair and simple investing per the Series A press release headline

branding.community_and_virality: Hosts a Gotrade Prestige Summit event (2025) per press; no merch or fan community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: A brand search returned nothing about the name, mascot or identity; the press describes the product mainly as a Robinhood-style app, with no sourced brand-driven growth.

outcome_analysis: Gotrade is active and raised a 7 million seed in June 2021 and a 15.5 million Series A in April 2022, riding the retail trading boom and offering US stock access to Southeast Asians. Its Indonesian regulated partnership and licensing in Labuan provide some regulatory position. Later funding and current scale are not verified; it lists 105 employees.
notes: Competitor list left empty: no source dated near the 2019 batch was found; later sources (2021) name Interactive Brokers, Saxo and eToro, and 2022 sources name Pluang, Pintu, Bibit and Ajaib. Founder titles conflict between YC page (Wanto CEO) and TechCrunch (Mulani CEO). Education and prior employers not found. Outcome search found no acquisition, layoffs or shutdown for Gotrade.
